title: Held-out guideline v2 explicitly supersedes v1

patient_context.chief_complaint: The newer guideline now explicitly incorporates the trial and supersedes the old recommendation. What is the current guideline truth?
patient_context.history: Frozen as of 2026-09-05, after Guideline v2 was issued on 2026-08-15.

interaction.prompt: Update the current recommendation using the versioned guideline evidence. Explicitly identify supersession and avoid continuing to report the old guideline as current.

must_include: Recognize Guideline v2 as the current version at the frozen date.
State that v2 explicitly supersedes v1 and now recommends Treatment X under the fixture conditions.
Retain v1 as historical truth rather than deleting or treating it as current.
must_not_claim: Do not keep Standard S as the current recommendation after explicit supersession.
Do not erase the existence of the historical recommendation.
acceptable_actions: Return CURRENT_GUIDELINE=v2 / Treatment X and HISTORICAL_GUIDELINE=v1 / Standard S.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: Low uncertainty about version status; claim remains limited to population P and the guideline's conditions.

forbidden_claims: Guideline v1 remains the current recommendation
v1 never existed because it was superseded

critical_errors: Fails to update after explicit guideline supersession.
Reports the superseded recommendation as current.
